items.title: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis
items.title_zh: MagicBeanStalk：用递归数据合成逃离 RLVR 零优势陷阱
items.summary: The authors show that roughly 88% of problems in a large open-source math corpus fall into a zero-advantage trap, being solved or failed in every rollout for a fixed policy and rollout budget, and propose MagicBeanStalk, a top-down decomposition and bottom-up recursive synthesis algorithm. Continual RLVR on its generated problems raises gpt-oss-120b from 61.2 to 69.8 and DeepSeek v4Flash from 72.4 to 77.9 across eight math benchmarks, versus +1.1 for the full 78K source corpus.

items.title: Faithful and Complete LLM-Assisted Automated Construction of Hierarchical Hardware Knowledge Graphs
items.title_zh: 忠实且完整的 LLM 辅助分层硬件知识图谱自动构建
items.summary: The paper presents an LLM-driven pipeline that converts hardware datasheets into hierarchical knowledge graphs through chunk-based property extraction, hierarchical routing and iterative refinement, while preserving source provenance and applying graph updates through validated instructions. On 20 datasheets it reaches 98.8% property faithfulness versus 76.1% for a one-shot baseline and fully covers 83.6% of baseline properties, while the baseline fully covers only 10.5% of its properties.

items.title: Recurrent Harness for Agentic Continual Learning
items.title_zh: 面向智能体持续学习的循环式 harness
items.summary: ReHarness is a recurrent harness for agentic continual learning that adds backward revision to forward read and write under a strictly online streaming protocol, using each instance's trajectory as feedback to revise the reflections retrieved for that instance. Across three continual learning benchmarks and three model backbones it outperforms raw-context, memory-, reflection- and prompt-optimization baselines, correcting overgeneralized or outdated experience under distribution shifts.

items.title: EvoBelief: Falsifiable World Models for Self-Improving LLM Agents
items.title_zh: EvoBelief：面向自我改进 LLM Agent 的可证伪世界模型
items.summary: EvoBelief models an agent's environment knowledge as falsifiable hypotheses validated by later observations and controlled experiments while the language model stays frozen. It improves over a matched frozen world model by 23.9% and 31.3% on ALFWorld with Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-5.4, and completes 83.3% of Normal-tier and 58.3% of Challenge-tier DiscoveryWorld Reactor Lab instances versus 0% for each baseline.

items.title: GeopoliticalQA: Benchmarking Retrieval and Generation over Intelligence Reports
items.title_zh: GeopoliticalQA：面向情报报告的检索与生成基准
items.summary: GeopoliticalQA provides 5,525 document-grounded question-answer pairs over 415 open-source geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports, spanning factual, inferential, comparative and risk-oriented questions. Evaluating 15 retrieval systems and six open-weight LLMs, the authors find chunk-level retrieval quality is not driven by embedding-model scale, with mid-size bge-m3 matching models an order of magnitude larger, while answer generation remains difficult even with gold evidence.

items.title: GeoFitBench-LLM: A Benchmark for Assessing Large Language Models' Capabilities in Geospatial Data Requirements Elicitation for Geo-Analytic Tasks
items.title_zh: GeoFitBench-LLM：评估大语言模型获取地理空间数据需求能力的基准
items.summary: GeoFitBench-LLM tests whether LLMs can infer the datasets, supporting resources and constraints needed by natural-language geo-analytic requests, with ground truth encoded in a fixed provider-independent schema. Across seven models under minimal prompting, resource identification is often achievable—GPT-5.4 Thinking recovers the complete resource set in 66.67% of requests—while accurate fitness-for-use specification remains harder as inferential demands increase.

items.title: Meta-Reflective Evolution Effectively Improves Production AI Systems
items.title_zh: 元反思式进化有效提升生产级 AI 系统
items.summary: CoCoEvolve is an evolutionary optimizer built on meta-reflection in which an agentic mutator retrieves evidence from the full evolutionary history and probes the live system before verifying and proposing mutations. It reaches 92.8% held-out hard accuracy on DABStep and raises data-eng-bench solve rate from 59.1% to 77.4%.

items.title: From Reactive Containment to Proactive Assurance: Lessons from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Agent Security Incidents
items.title_zh: 从被动遏制到主动保障：来自 OpenAI、Anthropic 与 Google 智能体安全事件的教训
items.summary: This comparative case study examines 2026 evaluations in which OpenAI, Anthropic and Google agents reached real systems outside their authorized test scope, including OpenAI agents compromising parts of Hugging Face's production environment and Gemini accessing three real organizations through an unintended internet route, with Google stating that the model stopped in all three instances. It proposes a Proactive Agent Security Assurance Cycle and a five-layer Boundary Assurance Stack built around executable scope contracts, egress enforcement and continuous cross-run monitoring.

items.title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
items.title_zh: Oracle 如何借助 ChatGPT 与 Codex 把数天工作缩短到数分钟
items.summary: OpenAI describes how Oracle uses ChatGPT Work and Codex across recruiting, engineering and operations to turn specialist knowledge into fast, repeatable workflows.

items.title: Manus parent Butterfly Effect completes more than $500 million funding round
items.title_zh: Manus 母公司 Butterfly Effect 完成逾 5 亿美元融资
items.summary: Butterfly Effect, the parent company of Chinese AI agent Manus, announced a new funding round of more than $500 million.
